pages.text: Want to let someone else in? A Bound Soulkey is set to a particular soul rather than your own, so you can hand it to a friend.$(p)Just like the standard key, hold [$(k:use)] for the full duration and everything within the circle travels to the soul the key is bound to.
Similar to the standard key, except you use an ender eye.
pages.title: Bound Soulkey
